metadata.name: Pharaoh's Reach
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A temple complex on the Nile (Style Pack 09: Sands of Egypt). A sphinx avenue leads from the quay between obelisks and seated colossi to a painted pylon (climb its back stairs to the roof walk), a hypostyle hall of painted columns and the sanctuary. East stands a step pyramid with a sniper's perch on top; west, stairs under a mastaba lead down to a painted tomb full of spike pits, fire jets and a crushing ceiling. Touch the sarcophagus and the pharaoh's curse goes off and seals the portal that links the burial chamber to the top of the pyramid. A ferry crosses to the village on the north bank.

do.text: The pharaoh's curse! The tomb portal seals.
